name: P06 doors need Confirm — no walk-in

steps.note: Standing on a doorstep must NOT auto-enter — walk triggers are gone

steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const pw=await import('/src/world/maps/puddlewick.js');const L=pw.puddlewickLayout();const Field=(await import('/src/world/field.js')).Field;const plots=['hollybank','puddlewick_inn','puddlewick_shop','puddlewick_twins','puddlewick_chapel'];const out=[];for(const plot of plots){const far=L.spots.doors[plot];const doorProp=()=>{const w=Field.world();const d=L.buildings.find(b=>b.id===plot);void d;return (w.map.props||[]).find(p=>p.type==='door'&&Math.hypot(p.x-(L.doors[plot]?.x||far.x),p.z-(L.doors[plot]?.z||far.z))<4);};__DQ.teleport('puddlewick',far.x,far.z);await sleep(900);out.push({plot,afterStand:__DQ.state().map.id,stood:__DQ.state().map.id==='puddlewick'});}window.__STAND=out;return JSON.stringify(out);})()

steps.note: Confirm / door.talk still enters every room

steps.eval: (async()=>{const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));const m=await import('/src/world/maps/puddlewick.js');const r=await import('/src/world/maps/int_rooms.js');const Field=(await import('/src/world/field.js')).Field;const doors=m.puddlewickLayout().doors;const out=[];for(const D of r.DOORS){__DQ.teleport('meadow',0,0);await sleep(700);const d=doors[D.plot];__DQ.teleport('puddlewick',d.x,d.z);for(let i=0;i<20&&__DQ.state().map.id!=='puddlewick';i++)await sleep(150);await sleep(350);if(__DQ.state().map.id!=='puddlewick'){out.push({plot:D.plot,want:D.room,err:'left puddlewick without talk',map:__DQ.state().map.id,ok:false});continue;}const w=Field.world();const door=(w.map.props||[]).find(p=>p.type==='door'&&Math.hypot(p.x-d.x,p.z-d.z)<2.5)||(w.map.props||[]).find(p=>p.type==='door');if(!door){out.push({plot:D.plot,want:D.room,err:'no door prop',ok:false});continue;}door.talk({field:Field});for(let i=0;i<25&&__DQ.state().map.id==='puddlewick';i++)await sleep(150);await sleep(300);out.push({plot:D.plot,want:D.room,went:__DQ.state().map.id,ok:__DQ.state().map.id===D.room,how:'talk'});}window.__TALK=out;return JSON.stringify(out);})()
